android.desc:
Hello there! 
The Open Diaries is the perfect Diary writing app. 
A safe and beautiful place to empty your thoughts and clear your mind.
Write your day in your private diary and keep them locked. Or share them with the world using an anonymous pen name. It is free, secure and personalised. 


Public Notes will be visible to everyone on the app. You can edit the privacy of your notes anytime. It also features switching between different wallpapers and fonts to help you get into the perfect diary writing mood ^_^  

You can also send letters to your future self to remind yourself of a diary entry after 10 Years...!

Built with lots of Love... :)
The Open Diaries team 

Highlights:  
Privacy & Security:
All diaries are locked & saved in private mode by default.
Diary can be set to open diary mode only by the writer
No question of diary leakage - all diaries are stored in a secure server

Diary styling: 
Variety of fonts, background images and mood colours to choose from.
Insert pictures, emojis, website links as and when you wish
Quote important parts of your diary
Create lists for different agendas like storing recipes, health journaling etc..

Diary back up & sharing:
Back up your diaries easily with easy-share option 
Share memorable entries with special ones 
Share via various media like mail, WhatsApp, and social media 

Languages available: 
Write in the language of your choice  :)

Use open diaries as your daily diary, event journal, thought tracker, fitness planner,...and just about any kind of journal you want it to be! 
So what are you waiting for?
Check it out! 
^_^

Team ToD

quotes.text: thanks @nikoleA. You can also find android app link here - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.feturtles.theopendiaries
